_comment: Quick three-factor comparison on 6x6 Sudoku (2x3 boxes, data/sudoku6_lt.npz from data/make_sudoku6.py: 1,000 minimal training puzzles x augmentation, 2,048 test). Same bands EMA model as configs/tf/base.json but small: width 128 (4 heads of 32), 8 blocks per segment all backpropagated x 8 segments = 64 blocks per puzzle; the milestone extrapolates to 64 segments (8x the training depth, as base.json). Arms add only their flags (scripts/tf_runs.sh).
